_instructions: Fill this in once per session before running the pipeline. This context is injected into every LLM call to ground the narrative.
setting: e.g. Dark gothic fantasy. The land of Barovia, a valley trapped under the rule of the vampire Strahd von Zarovich.
current_arc: e.g. The party has just arrived in the village of Barovia and is investigating rumors of missing children.
recent_events: e.g. The party defeated a pack of wolves on the road and found a mysterious letter signed by the Count.
